programs.title: Universal Language
programs.desc: Two women find frozen cash, try to retrieve it. A tour guide leads tourists around Winnipeg sites. A man quits his job and visits his mother.

programs.title: Gem & Shaz
programs.desc: Two Asian Canadian teenage girls are given one hour at the school dance by their strict immigrant parents and are determined to make the most of it.

programs.title: Selena + Chef
programs.desc: Pastry chef and activist Paola Velez comes ready with a sweet treat for Selena, helping her create a chocolate cookie icebox cake; also on the menu are beef empanadas.

programs.title: Selena + Chef
programs.desc: Selena is joined in person for a special, fast-paced lesson with culinary icon Gordon Ramsay; the two prepare a luxurious feast with butter-basted steak, pan-seared scallops, smashed potatoes and chimichurri.

programs.title: Devotion
programs.desc: The inspirational true story of Jesse Brown, the first Black aviator in U.S. Navy history, and his enduring friendship with fellow fighter pilot Tom Hudner. Helping to turn the tide in the most brutal battle in the Korean War, their heroic sacrifices ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.

programs.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
programs.desc: The year is 1926, and Newt Scamander (Eddie Redmayne) has just completed a global excursion to find and document an extraordinary array of magical creatures. Arriving in New York for a brief stopover, he might have come and gone without incident, were it not for a No-Maj (American for Muggle) named Jacob, a misplaced magical case, and the escape of some of Newt's fantastic beasts, which could spell trouble for both the wizarding and No-Maj worlds.
